For the shipment named in the INI, rewrite ship_date in the page's extended ISO 8601 complete calendar-date format, using the numeric year, month, and day from the CSV. Actually edit exports/dispatch.ini. Replace only the value after ship_date=; keep every other line and file unchanged.
